question.text: Total Exposure of a Cat III AIF to derivatives = Long positions + Short positions (after offsetting). If Net Exposure NIFTY Options = Rs. 36 lakh, Stock Futures LMN = Rs. 17.0625 crore, Gold Futures = Rs. 23.775 crore. Total Exposure?

explanation.text: The Logic: Total Exposure = 36 lakh + 17.0625 crore + 23.775 crore = Rs. 41.1975 crore. The Trap: Other values ignore one or more components. Cross-Exam Context: Directly from Example 4 in Section 8.2.2. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Run total-exposure calculation at end of each trading day to monitor leverage.
